nodes.label: Expo SDK 54 to 57 upgrade
nodes.rationale: Records the mobile upgrade and what was checked only on a workstation, not on a device.

nodes.label: Expo SDK 57
nodes.rationale: Upgraded from Expo 54.0.x to 57.0.31 with npx expo install expo@^57.0.0 --fix, plus expo-splash-screen. React Native moved from 0.81.5 to 0.86.3, which includes the Hermes V1 memory fix and needs expo >= 57.0.9. React moved from 19.1.0 to 19.2.3, including root overrides and apps/backend. TypeScript moved from 5.9 to 6.0.x, Expo's expected version. newArchEnabled was removed because New Architecture is the only architecture from SDK 55. The top-level splash config moved into the expo-splash-screen plugin. Expo added the expo-image, expo-sharing, and expo-status-bar config plugins.

nodes.label: Hermes V1
nodes.source_location: Not checked, do on a device (release build, low-end Android and iOS)
nodes.rationale: Default JavaScript engine since SDK 56. Not yet checked on a device. Opt out with useHermesV1 set to false in expo-build-properties if wallet create/restore, signing, QR or SMS payload generation, or memory misbehaves on a low-end phone.

nodes.label: Stellar SDK
nodes.source_location: Not checked, do on a device (release build, low-end Android and iOS)
nodes.rationale: The wallet runs the Stellar SDK on Hermes V1. The custom Metro alias for it still resolved in the Android Hermes export (1420 modules, 4.2 MB).

nodes.label: ed25519
nodes.source_location: Not checked, do on a device (release build, low-end Android and iOS)
nodes.rationale: Wallet signing uses ed25519 on Hermes V1 and still needs a low-end device check.

nodes.label: bip39
nodes.source_location: Not checked, do on a device (release build, low-end Android and iOS)
nodes.rationale: Wallet mnemonic create and restore use bip39 on Hermes V1 and still need a low-end device check.

nodes.label: expo/fetch
nodes.source_location: Not checked, do on a device (release build, low-end Android and iOS)
nodes.rationale: Global fetch is now expo/fetch. services/api/client.ts uses fetch with AbortController. Set EXPO_PUBLIC_USE_RN_FETCH=1 to return to the React Native fetch if requests misbehave.

nodes.label: react-native-worklets
nodes.source_location: Not checked, do on a device (release build, low-end Android and iOS)
nodes.rationale: Version 0.10.1 is installed, but nothing imports it and Reanimated is not installed. The upgrade note says to add Reanimated when the v2 design needs it, or to remove worklets.

nodes.label: Expo SDK 58
nodes.rationale: SDK 58 (React Native 0.88) was released 2026-10-15 and was not taken. Revisit after its first patch releases. It also turns on ios.enableSceneSupport by default; iOS 27 builds need that flag.

nodes.label: mobile-ci Node 20
nodes.source_location: Not checked, do on a device (release build, low-end Android and iOS)
nodes.rationale: At the time of the upgrade note, mobile-ci.yml used a floating Node 20. React Native 0.86 needs Node >= 20.19.4.

nodes.label: expo-media-library
nodes.source_location: Not checked, do on a device (release build, low-end Android and iOS)
nodes.rationale: The old API is deprecated and still works. The old UI uses it to save the payment QR to the gallery.

nodes.label: Managed Expo config
nodes.source_location: Not checked, do on a device (release build, low-end Android and iOS)
nodes.rationale: There is no android/ or ios/ folder, so native modules require a new dev client or EAS build. Expo Go does not apply that native rebuild. iOS on SDK 56 and newer requires Xcode 26.4 and iOS 16.4 or newer. Workstation checks passed: expo-doctor 21/21, mobile tsc with 0 errors, backend tsc with 0 errors after prisma generate, and an Android export to Hermes bytecode.
